Name: CCTV Log Mod
Author: GoldenMagikarp0512
Description:
CCTV Log Mod is designed for multiplayer farms with shared resources, focusing on transparency and accountability between players.
By crafting and placing a dedicated Log Terminal, players can review activity logs in one centralized interface. All logs are recorded silently in the background and can be checked at any time without notifications or chat spam.
The mod bundles repetitive actions into clean, readable entries to avoid log flooding.
Actions viewable through the Log Terminal include:
- Crafting detection with automatic bundling
- Shipping Bin results (processed at nightly settlement, for both host and guests)
- Trash can disposal detection
- Object placement detection with bundling
- Object destruction detection with bundling
- Machine input detection (based on placed machines, with bundling)
- Shop income and expense tracking with aggregated totals
- Building construction request detection
- Tool upgrade request detection
This mod requires SMAPI and is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.
Korean translation is included.
